text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Eeh...?! Is that... the "Black King"?! I can't believe he's been resurrected...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇっ……！　
あれは
黒の王っ！？
まさか復活してるなんて……！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: I don't know about this Miroku, Micro or whatever... but he's done something he shouldn't have! I'll beat the crap out of this thing again if I have to!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミロクだかミクロだかなんだかしらねーですけど、
余計なことしやがるですね！
こうなったら
またボッコボコにしてやるですよーっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: What's that? Did you all have a fight against this monster before?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ？
おまえら、
アイツとケンカしたことあんのか？

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: "Power of hope"...? What does that mean?
text_block_list.orig_text:
希望の力……？　
どういうこと？

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: The "Black King's" weakness is the hope we all hold. By gathering everyone's hope into my bow and arrow, I originally defeated him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
黒の王の弱点は、
私たちが抱く希望なんです。
みんなの希望を私の弓矢に集めることで、
あいつを倒したんですよ。

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: It's just that, um... I was only able to use that power in the picture book world. I honestly don't know if it's possible to do the same thing in this world...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただ、
その……
その力が使えたのは、
絵本の中の話で。
こっちの世界で同じようにできるかは、
正直分かりません……

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Ughhhh... You're right... There certainly is a difference between a picture book and the world outside of it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ～……
そうですよね……
絵本と現実は違いますから……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Geez! What are you two rambling on about?! We were able to defeat it that way last time, so let's just try it! Now that you understand, everyone, show off your "hope"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もー！　
二人とも、
何うだうだ言ってるですか！？
前はそれで倒せたんだから、
とりあえずやってみるですっ！
ほらみんな、
分かったらさっさと希望を持つですよ！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Hope, huh? Then leave it to me♪ There's a lot that Big Sis wants to do with you, little brother! Like going on dates, taking baths together, lounging around together, and also~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
希望か～。
それなら任せて♪
お姉ちゃん、
これからも弟くんとやりたいこといっぱいあるから！
デートしたり～、
一緒にお風呂入ったり
ゴロゴロしたり～、
あとあと～♪

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's not fair that you're the only one having fun, Big Sis! I-I haven't given up on such hopes either, you know! When things return peaceful, I'll have Onii-chan dote on me a lot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
お姉ちゃんばっかりズルいです！
わ、
私だって、
そういう希望は捨ててませんよ！？
平和になったらお兄ちゃんにいっぱい構ってもらいますっ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: An older sister fawning on Senpai... and a younger sister wishing to be doted on by Senpai, huh...? I-I might want to observe what happens with them for future reference...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんに甘える先輩と、
妹の面倒を見る先輩かぁ……
こ、
今後の参考のために、
私も観察しておきたいかも……！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: U-Uwaah... Y-You've got it rough, {0}... I'll treat you to some food next time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわ……
キ、
キミって
大変なんだな……
今度メシでもおごってやるよ……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: He-he-he. Now that's a good dose of HOPE! Now, turn that into strength and defeat the "Black King"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふ。
いい感じに希望を抱きやがりましたね！
じゃあそれを力に変えて、
黒の王をやっつけるですよーっ！
